title: Horner Syndrome in 60 Seconds (PMA)
description:
Horner syndrome is interruption of the sympathetic pathway to the eye: ptosis, miosis and anhidrosis on the same side. Causes can be serious, classically a lung apex (Pancoast) tumour or carotid artery dissection, so the cause is always investigated.

Sources:
• StatPearls: Horner Syndrome (NBK500000): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29763176/
• ACR Appropriateness Criteria: Horner Syndrome. J Am Coll Radiol 2025: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41193044/
